articles.title: Bitcoin crashes to 3-month low below $63,000 as analyst flags fourth capitulation wave
articles.snippet: "They are now selling at the very price they wish they had taken advantage of three months ago," wrote James Check.

articles.title: Nvidia turmoil tests Bitcoin miners’ AI funding plans
articles.snippet: Nvidia’s leadership upheaval and Texas permit restrictions sharpen the divide between miners with funded projects and those still seeking capital and approvals.

articles.title: Bitcoin falls to 4-month low near $62K as crypto selloff deepens
articles.snippet: The global cryptocurrency market capitalization fell 4% to $2.26 trillion over 24 hours, while Ether and Solana posted double-digit weekly losses.
